bullets.text: The Velachery flyover project remains in limbo after the Corporation was cleared to proceed following CMRL review.
A youth named Hariprasad tragically died after falling into a stormwater drain pit near the Ambattur industrial estate.
Chennai Traffic Police announced a five-day traffic diversion in Adambakkam starting November 11 for underground sewage pipeline work.
Four consultancy firms submitted bids to prepare a Detailed Project Report for four model urban mobility corridors in Chennai.
A new traffic alleviation project is planned across key roads including Taramani, Velachery, and Tambaram.
The National Green Tribunal reserved its verdict on a plea by CREDAI challenging construction bans around the Pallikaranai marshland.
Document writers and typists in Gummidipoondi went on strike protesting the government's move to privatize the registration department.
A massive 10-foot deep crater formed on the PTMs main road in Pattabiram due to a drinking water pipe burst.
Collector Kavitha announced that the Uzhaithai Thaedi Ungal Ooril camp will be held in Poonamallee taluk on November 18.
The Andhra Pradesh cabinet approved major technology policies and a 31,387-crore rupee Vizag data centre chaired by Chief Minister Naidu.
The Digital India BHASHINI Division signed an MoU with Manipur to advance multilingual AI and language technology at a workshop.
MeitY launched the DEPA for AI training handbook to establish a techno-legal framework for trusted data collaboration.
Chief Minister Vijay started consultations with TVK MLAs at a Mamallapuram hotel amidst opposition criticism over law and order issues.
BJP leader Nainar Nagenthiran issued a statement strongly condemning the government over the missing girl incident in Gingee.
Fifty TVK functionaries in Puzhuthivakkam left the party and officially joined the DMK.
Chief Minister Vijay virtually inaugurated Raptee.HV's flagship electric vehicle experience centre in Chennai, backed by TIDCO investment.
Chief Minister Vijay playfully examined a miniature electric bike model during the virtual inauguration event for Raptee.HV.
